mapper.select: SELECT content::text FROM viewer_annotation_document WHERE result_id = #{resultId}

choose.when: INSERT INTO viewer_annotation_document(result_id, content, version) VALUES (#{resultId}, CAST(#{content} AS jsonb), 1) ON CONFLICT (result_id) DO NOTHING
choose.otherwise: UPDATE viewer_annotation_document SET content = CAST(#{content} AS jsonb), version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE result_id = #{resultId} AND version = #{version}
